text.formatted:
The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

|   Paladin Level | Spells                                                 |
|-----------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|               3 | Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith |
|               5 | Aid, Zone of Truth                             |
|               9 | Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic                   |
|              13 | Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith         |
|              17 | Commune, Flame Strike                          |
